data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘hakama’ meaning ‘to be wise, to be intelligent, to have knowledge’. The name Hakeema is a feminine form and is associated with a woman of wisdom, knowledge, and understanding in Islamic culture. The name Hakeema carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hakeema usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
